about: The hazard list (Rule 3, T-503, US-27). Each entry is a pattern matched, without regard to case, against the sentences of the manual passages an answer uses. A matching sentence is shown in the manual's own words, ahead of the first step taken from that passage. 'kind': 'hazard' is a warning. 'consult' is the manual telling the reader to go to a dealer in some situation: shown as a warning marked professional-only. 'stop' marks work the user must not be walked through: the passage is withheld from the model, and the answer stops there with the sentence as its reason. This is a starter list written from the wording of the 27 Shimano manuals; the 'stop' marks are the team's to author (see ADR 0004, open items).
